input.summary: Vembanad Botanicals (V03). Quote received with commercial proposal (Vembanad_Commercial_Proposal.docx) and rosemary COA (batch VB-RM-2411-03). Open issue: rosemary COA retest date 2026-11-30 is before our 20 Dec 2026 need-by (RM-008, 3 tries left). Knockout gaps open: COA for each line (Q|B5), SDS with transport class (Q|H1). Asked non-knockout items: OTIF, rejection rate, need-by feasibility, Incoterm, kg conversion. No promises or refusals yet. Vendor response requested by 14 Nov 2026.

input.subject: RFx KPC-2026-014: Rosemary COA and outstanding information
input.body:
Dear Meera,

Thank you for your proposal and the rosemary COA for batch VB-RM-2411-03.

1. Rosemary leaf extract (RM-008): the COA shows a retest date of 30 November 2026, which falls before our first need-by date of 20 December 2026. Please provide a current COA for a batch with a retest or expiry date that covers delivery and at least 6 months of use after receipt.

2. Please provide a COA for each of the ten lines in this RFx, showing batch number, manufacturing date and expiry or retest date.

3. Please provide the current Safety Data Sheet for each line, including the transport hazard class.

4. State your on-time-in-full (OTIF) rate for these lines over the last 12 months, with your definition of on-time.

5. State your rejection rate for these lines over the last 12 months, with the period and basis used.

6. Can you meet the need-by date of 20 December 2026 for the first delivery? If not, state your earliest date.

7. State the Incoterm and delivery point, and whether freight, insurance and packing are included. If not, state the amount.

8. Give the conversion from your selling unit to kilograms of net material for each line (Annexure A is acceptable).

Please reply by 14 November 2026.

Kind regards,
Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
